blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur – Amid intense public backlash over the skating ban on Siargao’s famed Malinao “Skate Road,” the municipal government of General Luna has unveiled plans to construct a dedicated seaside skate park to provide a permanent home for the island’s displaced skating community. The proposed tourism infrastructure project, unveiled Monday and envisioned to rise along an existing 350-meter-plus seawall in Barangay 1, Poblacion, is being positioned by the local government unit as a long-term solution that balances public safety laws with the island’s vibrant board-riding culture.
